title: data API refusal: fields[] lists the union head as an "Invalid input" invalid_shape entry ahead of the entries that explain it (sibling of #35400)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Filing gate: ② maintainer-directed sibling. Ruling 7003683081 on #35400: "The data API's sibling wrapper is out of this card and gets its own finding card." Evidence from the #35400 os-dev report (`/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat5/area-ux/ux-3/report-35400.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade.

## What the caller sees

A data-API write refused on a union-typed field gets, in `fields[]`, an entry `{ field, code: 'invalid_shape', message: 'Invalid input' }` ahead of the branch entries that name the real cause. It is the record-door twin of the metadata-save wrapper #35400 removes.

## Where

- Producer: `packages/spec/src/api/zod-issues-to-fields.ts` (docblock ~:137, push ~:214), `zodIssuesToFields`.
- Consumers: `packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts` (~:320, :583, :640) and the REST `createValidationError`.
- Pinned: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/union-branch-policy.cross-package-parity.test.ts` ~:420-421 (codes `['invalid_shape','required']`).
- Taught: `content/docs/api/error-handling-server.mdx` ~:179-183 ("that entry PLUS the entries of the branch").

## Why it is a separate decision

It is a published response shape (`fields[]`, ADR-0114 catalog) taught in the docs. Whether it follows #35400's rule is its own contract choice; the maintainer's #5364 ruling kept the metadata envelope and `fields[]` from being aligned. Any change is `packages/spec/src` non-test (L2 contract record).

Dedupe: issue search `invalid_shape union wrapper fields`, `zodIssuesToFields union head`, `data API Invalid input fields entry` → only #35400.
